edges.reason: block.timestamp (now) is compared against startDate and endDate and gates buyTokens execution, making logic timestamp dependent
startDate is read in require(now >= startDate) inside buyTokens
endDate is read in require(now < endDate) inside buyTokens
tokenPrice is read to compute the token amount in buyTokens
msg.sender is used as purchaser and beneficiary of buyTokens
buyTokens executes amount = msg.value * 1000000000000000000 / tokenPrice
buyTokens executes bonus = amount * bonusPercentage / 100
buyTokens invokes mint(msg.sender, amount + bonus) without an explicit caller permission check at that point
Computed amount flows into the bonus calculation
Computed bonus plus amount flows as the minted value of the mint invocation
msg.sender is used as the recipient of the minted tokens inside buyTokens
buyTokens calls the public mint function which enforces hasMintPermission (owner only)
The payable fallback function forwards all calls to buyTokens
transfer performs balances[msg.sender].sub(_value) and balances[_to].add(_value)
transferFrom performs allowed[_from][msg.sender].sub(_value)
_mint performs totalSupply_ = totalSupply_.add(_amount)
mint calls the internal _mint after the cap check
The constructor calls _mint(msg.sender, 7500000000000000000000000)
msg.sender is the constructor mint recipient and inherited owner
Parameter _to is the destination of the transfer
Parameter _value is the amount subtracted and added in transfer
Parameter _from is the source account of transferFrom
Parameter _to is the destination of transferFrom
Parameter _value is the amount moved in transferFrom

Parameter _value is stored as the allowance in approve
